title: How Michigan’s Midterm Senate Race Could Influence the 2028 Democratic Presidential Primary
summary: The fate of Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the progressive candidate in the race, will serve as a litmus test for the left’s potency heading into the next presidential contest.
